rules.note_prices: Quantity-specific legal prices; confirmed 9045->45 and 9072->72 OCR concatenations repaired before aggregation; unknown values fail validation
rules.shelves: Keep kernel drinks; sample remaining discount tiers from the exact conditional four-of-eight shelf law (at most two half-price slots), then empirical marginal note sizes; middle initial shops retain the kernel half-price prior
rules.note_product_identity: Uniform among tower drop-group notes, independent of selected skills
rules.battle_notes: Eight individual uniform draws per battle by default; uncalibrated, evaluate sensitivity
rules.initial_supply: Actual local wiki per-sigil supportSupply, not a blanket eight per type
rules.note_events: Client-table effects with uniform random-note draws; generic fixed-note IDs 10701..10707; any-note costs use a deterministic least-loss donor
rules.visibility: All modeled note options exposed for 107/108/114; actual server option sampling is unknown
rules.event_legality: All visible table options, without ordinary-objective dominance pruning; coin costs, every positive-mass wallet outcome and note costs checked before selection
rules.adjustments: At terminal, at most 15 one-for-one transfers between any owned donor and a required target; legality/timing need game evidence
rules.objective: Separate ordinary/concerto returns; lambda is an experimental preference, not measured damage
rules.scope: Offline research only, no Maa or live-game integration
